diff --git a/test/units/module_utils/facts/test_sysctl.py b/test/units/module_utils/facts/test_sysctl.py

index 0000000..4b05e13

@@ -0,0 +1,85 @@
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+import errno
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.sysctl import get_sysctl
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware import darwin, freebsd, netbsd, openbsd
+
+
+def test_get_sysctl_parses_formats_and_continues_after_bad_line(mocker):
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, 'hw.model: Device\n  revision A\nbroken\nhw.ncpu = 4\nkern.boottime 123\n', '')
+
+    assert get_sysctl(module, ['hw', 'kern']) == {
+        'hw.model': 'Device\n  revision A',
+        'hw.ncpu': '4',
+        'kern.boottime': '123',
+    }
+    module.run_command.assert_called_once_with(['/sbin/sysctl', 'hw', 'kern'])
+    assert module.warn.call_count == 1
+    assert module.warn.call_args[0][0].startswith('Unable to split sysctl line (broken): ')
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('result', [(1, '', 'permission denied'), OSError('unavailable')])
+def test_get_sysctl_command_failure_warns_and_returns_empty(mocker, result):
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    if isinstance(result, Exception):
+        module.run_command.side_effect = result
+        message = 'unavailable'
+    else:
+        module.run_command.return_value = result
+        message = 'permission denied'
+
+    assert get_sysctl(module, ['hw']) == {}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Unable to read sysctl: %s' % message)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('hardware', [freebsd.FreeBSDHardware, netbsd.NetBSDHardware,
+                                      openbsd.OpenBSDHardware, darwin.DarwinHardware])
+def test_bsd_uptime_uses_numeric_boot_time(mocker, hardware):
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, '100\n', '')
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.sysctl.time.time', return_value=250.8)
+
+    assert hardware(module).get_uptime_facts() == {'uptime_seconds': 150}
+    module.run_command.assert_called_once_with(['/sbin/sysctl', '-n', 'kern.boottime'])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('result', [(1, '100', 'not available'), (0, '', ''),
+                                     (0, '{ sec = 100 }', '')])
+def test_bsd_uptime_omits_unusable_boot_time(mocker, result):
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    module.run_command.return_value = result
+    assert freebsd.FreeBSDHardware(module).get_uptime_facts() == {}
+
+
+def test_bsd_uptime_missing_binary_raises(mocker):
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = None
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        freebsd.FreeBSDHardware(module).get_uptime_facts()
+
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    module.run_command.side_effect = OSError(errno.ENOENT, 'missing')
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        freebsd.FreeBSDHardware(module).get_uptime_facts()
+
+
+def test_openbsd_populate_keeps_all_fact_sources(mocker):
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    inst = openbsd.OpenBSDHardware(module)
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.openbsd.get_sysctl', return_value={})
+    for method, fact in [('get_processor_facts', 'processor_count'),
+                         ('get_memory_facts', 'memtotal_mb'), ('get_device_facts', 'devices'),
+                         ('get_dmi_facts', 'system_vendor'), ('get_mount_facts', 'mounts'),
+                         ('get_uptime_facts', 'uptime_seconds')]:
+        mocker.patch.object(inst, method, return_value={fact: 1})
+
+    assert inst.populate() == dict.fromkeys(('processor_count', 'memtotal_mb', 'devices',
+                                             'system_vendor', 'mounts', 'uptime_seconds'), 1)
